description: TRAINING EXAMPLES. 60 synthetic example questions, ten per intent, half in English and half in Indonesian. They were written from the intent definitions in kb/INTENTS.md and from the knowledge base topics, not from the test set. These are the labelled examples the Support Chat votes with, together with the knowledge base passages. The test set is kept apart in kb/intent-test-set.json. The dataset author reviewed all 60 on 12 October 2026 and approved them, except that T19 was shortened: its second half ("saya kewalahan") voiced a state rather than described the load.
